description:
Winter of Code 2026 is an open-source contribution program designed to help students and developers get started with real-world software development and open-source collaboration.

Participants will have the opportunity to explore open-source projects, contribute code, fix issues, improve documentation, and collaborate with project maintainers and fellow developers.

The program focuses on learning by doing, encouraging participants to build practical development skills, understand real-world Git and GitHub workflows, and make meaningful contributions to the open-source community.

Whether you are new to open source or already have development experience, Winter of Code 2026 provides an opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow as a developer.

hackathon_faqs.answer: IEEE Winter of Code 2026 is open to students worldwide. Students from any college, course, semester, or academic background can participate. You do not need to be a student of BMSIT&M or an IEEE member to participate.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate in IEEE Winter of Code 2026?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. IEEE Winter of Code 2026 is an individual participation event. You do not need to form a team to participate. Each participant can independently explore projects, work on issues, and submit contributions.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can I participate individually?

hackathon_faqs.answer: No. Participants at different stages of their technical journey are welcome to participate. The event is designed to provide hands-on learning and guidance while participants contribute to real-world open-source projects.
hackathon_faqs.question: Do I need open-source experience?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Participants can contribute to projects across different categories, including open-source organisations and GSoC-associated projects, startups and open-source organisations, college clubs and societies, individual projects with existing codebases, and early-stage projects.
hackathon_faqs.question: What kind of projects can I contribute to?

hackathon_faqs.answer: IEEE Winter of Code 2026 will take place from 15th October 2026 to 1st December 2026. Registration opens on 10th September 2026 and closes on 20th October 2026.
hackathon_faqs.question: When is IEEE Winter of Code 2026 taking place?
